errors.message: MCP error -32603: Server "open-food-facts-mcp" is misconfigured: its endpoint points back at the MCPize gateway (open-food-facts-mcp.mcpize.run), which would loop instead of reaching a real server. If you own this server, set its endpoint to your actual upstream URL under Dashboard → Servers → open-food-facts-mcp → Settings, or redeploy it so MCPize provisions hosting for you.
